name: 55414 · Minneapolis, MN
findings: ZIP 55414 (Minneapolis) has 231 nonprofit organizations. 133 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 116 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55414 (Minneapolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
